title: What If You Fell Into Neptune?

scenes.text: What if you fell into Neptune? There's no ground to land on. You'd just keep falling.
Neptune has no firm surface, only layers of gas around an icy mantle and a rocky core.
Its winds are the fastest in the solar system, about two thousand kilometers an hour. Earth's record is 408.
The air is eighty percent hydrogen, nineteen percent helium, and one point five percent methane, which tints it blue.
It's as cold as minus two hundred eighteen Celsius, and deeper down the pressure climbs to about fifty bars.
At the core, temperatures reach thousands of degrees under crushing pressure. You can't stand on Neptune. You can only sink.
